Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000404": On 2025-05-14 the Cinder team observed that webhooks' memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Cinder, webhooks)
- memory_id "1000368": As of 2025-04-29, the job scheduler still relies on the feature-flags service.  (about: feature-flags, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000364": As of 2025-04-24, the Cinder team reported that the feature-flags service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.  (about: Cinder, feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000357": Diego has the Cinder pager this cycle as of 2025-04-24, taking over from Yuki Tanaka.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder, Diego)
- memory_id "1000352" [constraint]: The indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11 until the full reindex completes.  (about: indexer, OpenSearch 2.11)
- memory_id "1000349" [decision]: The Dune team adopted a monthly game day.  (about: Dune team)
- memory_id "1000343": The product catalog keeps image metadata in a separate table because the joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000341" [decision]: The product catalog will keep image metadata in a separate table.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000328": The image resizer is a hard dependency of the product catalog.  (about: product catalog, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000325": The product catalog calls the image resizer for thumbnails.  (about: product catalog, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000276": The image resizer is owned by the Ember team as of 2025-03-20.  (about: Ember team, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000273" [constraint]: The product catalog can be released on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000246": The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Ember team as of 2025-03-03.  (about: webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000242": As of 2025-03-03, the pager for the webhook dispatcher rings the Ember team instead of the Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000180" [decision]: The Ember team does pairing on every production change.  (about: Ember team)
- memory_id "1000155": The indexer relies on the product catalog for product documents, so if the product catalog is down the indexer is down.  (about: product catalog, indexer)
- memory_id "1000118": The indexer is owned by Cinder.  (about: Cinder, indexer)
- memory_id "1000112": Cinder owns the product catalog.  (about: Cinder, product catalog)
- memory_id "1000026": Diego is on Cinder.  (about: Cinder, Diego)
- memory_id "1000021": Yuki Tanaka is on Cinder.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder)
